# Runpod — Runpod Startup Program

Two tiers: Growth Tier adds $25,000 in bonus credits on a $50,000 upfront commitment under a 12-month agreement; Starter Tier grants $1,000 in credits with self-serve onboarding.

### Tiers

Each tier has its own eligibility. A headline figure is usually the top tier, not
what a typical applicant receives.

| Tier | Amount | The vendor's wording | Gate |
|---|---|---|---|
| Growth Tier | $25,000 | Growth Tier members commit $50,000 upfront and receive $25,000 in bonus credits — giving you $75,000 total to start. | No partner needed |
| Starter Tier | $1,000 | Starter Tier members receive $1,000 in credits to get started on the platform. | No partner needed |

### Where it is available

**The vendor publishes no geographic restriction.** That is not the same as
confirming it is available where you are — check their terms before applying.

### Notes

No hard eligibility gate is published. The FAQ hedges on funding: "Venture backing is strongly preferred... That said, we review every application holistically" while also directing pre-funding/bootstrapped teams to self-serve pay-as-you-go instead, so funding_required and open_to_bootstrapped are left unknown. Existing customers are not categorically excluded: "The Runpod Startup Program is primarily designed for new customers onboarding for the first time. If you're an existing customer and your current spend is below the Growth Tier threshold, you may still be eligible." No company-age, headcount, region or incorporation criteria appear anywhere on the page. Independently re-audited: a second reviewer opened the vendor page and checked the quote, amount and source.
